prompt: A standard pack has 52 cards, including 4 kings. You shuffle and draw one card at random. What is the chance it is a king?
explanation: There are 4 kings among 52 cards, so the chance is 4 out of 52. Dividing top and bottom by 4 simplifies this to 1 in 13.
